name: Asia Metal Public Company Limited
summary: Asia Metal Public Company Limited produces and sells processed steel products in Thailand. It offers hot-rolled, pickled and oiled, and cold-rolled products to steel wholesalers and end user factories; and round, square, and rectangular steel pipes, as well as light lips channels and C-shaped furring. The company also trades in round-bars and deformed-bars, as well as square and round steel tubes. In addition, it provides steel cutting and modifying services. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Bang Phli, Thailand.
